dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Hey, Ayla! How was the break?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Enough of the small talk, Ella. Go ahead and verbally berate me or whatever else you want to do. I'm just trying to get to class.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Verbally berate...? Why would I do that?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Are you kidding? That's all you do. Find some other kid to pick on.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: Woah, Ayla, calm down! She never did anything to you, are you okay?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Dina, seriously? You aren't innocent either. All you do is gossip and spread rumors.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dina
dialogueEntries.text: We didn't do that, we swear!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ella
dialogueEntries.text: Ayla, I really don't know what you're talking about. But if there's something I did to upset you, we can talk about it.
Did whatever's happening to my dad affect Dina and Ella, too?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Sorry. I have to go. Talk later.
